h1: 5 Chang Palace — Container Rooms, the Best-Value Sleep Near Don Mueang
intro: If you have an early-morning flight out of Don Mueang, or simply need an affordable, no-fuss base in Bangkok's northern suburbs, 5 Chang Palace Hotel delivers on what matters most. Tucked into a quiet lane off Soi Ram Intra 5, this compact 18-room property was renovated in 2018 using repurposed shipping containers converted into private air-conditioned rooms — each with flat-screen TV, fridge, kettle, Wi-Fi, and an en-suite shower. Rates start at an honest ฿500–฿600 per night, with free on-site parking that almost no comparably priced hotel in Bangkok can match.

body.html: The premise is straightforward: standard shipping containers repurposed into compact hotel rooms, fitted with air conditioning, flat-screen TV, refrigerator, kettle, and a private bathroom with shower. At roughly 14 square metres per room, they are not spacious — but they are functional, and the price tag of ฿500–฿600 per night is almost unheard of for a private room with en-suite facilities in Bangkok. Based on feedback from verified guests, most describe the rooms as clean and comfortable for a one-night transit stay, even if they immediately register as compact.

The location sits in a quiet residential pocket of Bang Khen District, at Soi Ram Intra 5, Lane 9 (Anusawari Subdistrict). Don Mueang International Airport is 9.5 km away — a 15-to-20-minute drive. BTS Lat Pla Khao station (Green Line North) is about 1.6 km away, meaning you will need a motorcycle taxi or Grab to reach it. Once on the elevated rail, however, you can ride directly to Victory Monument, Mo Chit, and Siam with no transfers. Nearby points of interest include Wat Phra Si Mahathat, the Constitution Defence Monument, and Ying Charoen Saphan Mai Market.
"Clean and comfortable rooms. Despite being a container-style hotel, it was very comfortable to stay. Staff were extremely helpful." — Verified Agoda guest review

Staff friendliness is a consistent bright spot in guest reviews — front desk described as warm and accommodating, with a fast check-in process. The hotel offers free parking on the property, a genuinely valuable perk in this city. There is no restaurant, no swimming pool, and no gym — this is a sleep-and-go property designed for transit travellers and budget-conscious visitors, not a resort experience.

It is only fair to flag what real guests have criticised. Some reviews mention rust marks around window frames, broken fittings in certain units, and inconsistent housekeeping — including stained bed linen in isolated cases. The property appears to vary in upkeep from one container unit to the next. Beds tend to be firm in the Thai style; some international travellers find this uncomfortable. There is no lift on site, and front desk coverage is limited to 14:00–21:30 — if you plan a late arrival you should notify the property in advance.

Taken together, 5 Chang Palace Hotel makes the most sense for travellers who need to be near Don Mueang on a tight budget and have their own vehicle. At ฿500–฿600 per night with free parking, it undercuts every other private-room option in the area by a significant margin. If you need reliable, consistent quality and a short walk to the BTS, Petchsiri Boutique Hotel or Leelawadee Resotel are worth the slightly higher rate. But for a practical transit stay with honest value, this property delivers.

highlights.title: Closest to Don Mueang in the Area
highlights.text: Don Mueang International Airport is just 9.5 km away — a 15-to-20-minute drive. Ideal for early flights without paying airport-zone hotel prices.

highlights.title: Lowest Price in Bang Khen
highlights.text: From approx. ฿500/night for a private en-suite room in Bangkok. Add free on-site parking and the value proposition is hard to beat at this price point.

highlights.title: Free On-Site Parking
highlights.text: One of very few budget hotels in northern Bangkok offering free private parking. A key advantage for road-trippers arriving from upcountry provinces.

honestSummary: 5 Chang Palace Hotel is the right pick for budget travellers with a car who need to be near Don Mueang Airport. The price and free parking are its strongest cards. Be aware that room quality varies between units — guest reviews confirm this inconsistency clearly — so inspect your room at check-in and flag any issues before settling in.
honestChecks: If you are travelling with large luggage or as a group — 14 sq m container rooms will feel cramped. Consider 54 Place Saphan Mai or Petchsiri Boutique Hotel for more space at a similar price point.

If consistent cleanliness and room quality are non-negotiable — verified reviews show unit-to-unit variation. For a more predictable experience, Leelawadee Resotel Raminthra offers more reliable standards.
If you are relying entirely on public transport — BTS Lat Pla Khao is 1.6 km away (motorcycle taxi or Grab required each way). Properties directly next to a BTS station would serve you better.

tips.title: Early Flight from Don Mueang — Pre-Book Grab the Night Before
tips.body: The airport is 9.5 km away (15–20 min drive). For flights departing before 6:00 AM, book a Grab in advance through the app the evening before — early-morning availability can be limited in this residential area.

tips.title: Photograph Your Room on Arrival
tips.body: Given unit-to-unit variability, take photos of the room condition as soon as you check in and report any issues to front desk immediately — before unpacking your bags.

tips.title: Breakfast: Head to the Market Stalls Nearby
tips.body: No on-site restaurant, but street food stalls along Ram Intra open from 6:00 AM. For more variety, Ying Charoen Saphan Mai Market is about 10 minutes by Grab — excellent local breakfast at very low prices.

tips.title: Road-Trippers: Make the Most of Free Parking
tips.body: The free on-site car park is a genuine rarity at this price level in Bangkok. If you are driving from upcountry, this hotel likely saves you ฿100–฿200/night in parking fees compared with other options in the area.

faqTitle: FAQ — 5 Chang Palace Hotel, Bang Khen Bangkok

faq.q: Where is 5 Chang Palace Hotel and what is nearby?
faq.a: The hotel is at 14 Soi Ram Intra 5, Lane 9, Anusawari Subdistrict, Bang Khen District, Bangkok 10220. Nearby landmarks include Don Mueang Airport (9.5 km), BTS Lat Pla Khao (1.6 km), Wat Phra Si Mahathat, the Constitution Defence Monument, and Ying Charoen Saphan Mai Market.

faq.q: What are the room rates at 5 Chang Palace Hotel?
faq.a: Rates start at approximately ฿500–฿600 per night for the Budget Double Room (14 sq m, 1 queen bed). All rooms include air conditioning, flat-screen TV, fridge, kettle, free Wi-Fi, and a private bathroom with shower.

faq.q: How far is 5 Chang Palace Hotel from Don Mueang Airport?
faq.a: The hotel is 9.5 km from Don Mueang International Airport — approximately 15 to 20 minutes by car or Grab. For early-morning flights, book a Grab the evening before, as early-morning pickups in this residential area can take time.

faq.q: Does 5 Chang Palace Hotel have free parking?
faq.a: Yes — free on-site parking is available for hotel guests, one of the few properties at this price point in northern Bangkok to offer this.

faq.q: Who should stay at 5 Chang Palace Hotel?
faq.a: It is best suited for budget travellers with a car who need to be close to Don Mueang Airport, and solo or couple travellers who need only a clean, affordable overnight room. Not recommended for travellers who rely on public transport or expect hotel-standard amenities beyond the basics.
